FIFA lifts Balogun's ban, allowing him to play against Belgium

FIFA has unexpectedly overturned a red card suspension for U.S. striker Folarin Balogun, making him eligible for the World Cup match against Belgium. The decision, which came after Belgium was granted permission to appeal a ruling, has drawn thanks from former U.S. President Donald Trump. Balogun's teammates reportedly learned of the change via social media.
